explanation: Agnetha, Björn, Benny and Anni-Frid. A Swedish seafood company was already called Abba, and it agreed to let the band share the name.

claims.text: The name ABBA is made from the initials of its members' given names: Agnetha, Björn, Benny and Anni-Frid.
ABBA's name does not come from a Swedish word for joy, a song title or a street name.
A Swedish seafood company, Abba Seafood, already used the name and agreed to the band using it.

writerNotes: Self-check (§9.3). Lint: clean under content:check for writer w-pmusic02w. Argued against the key: the word abba also means father in Aramaic, but that is not where the band's name comes from. Volatility: evergreen; no time words, and nothing depends on knowledge newer than mid-2026. Regional: ABBA is known worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against content/reference/myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item. evidence.restatement: ABBA is an acronym of the first letters of Agnetha, Björn, Benny and Anni-Frid.
Because the name is an acronym of the members' first names, it is not a Swedish word for joy, a song title or a street name.

claimResults.note: High-risk (etymology): knowledge only. No pinned dataset covers it and WebSearch was unavailable to this run, so it still needs dataset or web evidence in a confirming check (§9.9 rule 3).

evidence.restatement: A Gothenburg seafood canning company already traded as Abba, and it gave the group permission to use the name.
ABBA is formed from the first letters of Agnetha, Bjorn, Benny and Anni-Frid.

claimResults.note: Rival test: not a Swedish word, street or song; the band itself explained it as an acronym. It is an etymology claim labelled standard; check A may still want to carry external evidence.

evidence.restatement: The name is an acronym of the members' given names, not a Swedish word for joy, a street name or a song title.
A Swedish fish-canning company, Abba Seafood, already used the name, and the band obtained its permission.
